title: Performance portable batched linear algebra kernels for transport sweeps using Kokkos
problem: Batched linear algebra kernels for neutron transport sweeps on GPUs require high performance across NVIDIA and AMD architectures; existing libraries may not be optimized for transport kernel patterns.
motivation: Neutron transport is compute-intensive; batched GESV (small system solvers) can achieve better GPU utilization; need performance-portable solution across architectures.
method: Custom batched GESV solver using Kokkos for performance portability. Optimizations: minimize global memory traffic, maximize compile-time computation. Evaluated on H100 (NVIDIA) and MI300A (AMD).
key_novelty: Custom batched GESV outperforming state-of-the-art libraries; performance portability across NVIDIA/AMD via Kokkos.
contributions: Optimized batched GESV solver for transport sweeps
Performance competitive with optimized CPU (128-core Genoa)
High performance on both H100 and MI300A
Memory-efficient design via minimized global traffic
primary_theme: Performance-portable batched linear algebra for neutron transport using Kokkos
